## Test math

Inline: $E = m c^2$

Display:

$$
E = m c^2
$$

## Test atoms

Test atoms is shown as @algo-test-atoms.

```pseudocode
#| label: algo-test-atoms
#| html-line-number: false
#| html-no-end: true
#| pdf-line-number: false

\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Test atoms}
\begin{algorithmic}
\State \textbf{Specials:} \{ \} \$ \& \# \% \_
\State \textbf{Bools:} \And \Or \Not \True \False
\State \textbf{Carriage return:} first line \\ second line
\State \textbf{Text-symbols:} \textbackslash
\State \textbf{Quote-symbols:} `single quotes', ``double quotes''
\State \textbf{Math:} $(\mathcal{C}_m)$, $i \gets i + 1$, $E=mc^2$, \( x^n + y^n = z^n \), $\$$, \(\$\)
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
```

## Test reference

Test atoms is shown as @algo-test-atoms.

## Test pseudocode in custom block

Test callout is shown as @algo-test-callout.

::: {.callout-note}
```pseudocode
#| label: algo-test-callout
#| pdf-placement: "H"

\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Test callout}
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{Test-Callout}{}
  \State CALLOUT TEST
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
```
:::
